tier2.caseDecision: Separate semantics, media-owner and ordinary-action examples cover pieces, not one download-card update path.
Useful preservation and font receipts exist; total-plus-button checkout contract lacks the question's long description and integrated design-font update path.
Review-scoped no-defect question with supporting Binding units; do not impose an invented implementation or require native semantic-tree tests.
State ownership is tested; actual completion-to-ticket wiring and safe fallback interpretation remain integration review work.
Direct native action pieces exist, but Save is an analogue for Delete and stable dispatcher acceptance needs its own reviewed grading witness.
Native action row and outline examples are different source sets. Do not equate a container flag or outline selection with full report-row grouping.
Project-policy review lane. No native execution required to answer the bounded evidence question; calibration and import/source evidence remain distinct.
Settings, form and document helpers are separate examples. Declaration card does not prove a composed card's updates or callbacks.
Main implementation-evidence gap: available text preference composition is not the requested checkout/Pay/design-font contract. A permanent flexible layout remains valid.
Same helper/integration boundary as iOS; a focus declaration does not validate callback ownership, fallback validity or delivered focus.
Region selection, media load owner and Play/Details examples are partial analogues; optional status/help and existing Open need a coherent contract.
Old ledger says no manifest, but reviewed bindings already identify media and closure receipts. Reuse those before proposing new tests.
Existing native helper contract covers current target and reentrancy at direct invocation. Keep actual dismissal completion wiring and generated-answer verification separate.
Document-state and native-bridge units do not by themselves prove installation or enabled-state handling of both SwiftUI action paths.
Compiled document composition and model landmark/selection tests support a partial grouping contract; the requested descriptive heading/balance and Open/Details composition still need source review.
Existing independently accepted task/alternative contract; retain review-only status until source and actual calibration records are reconciled.
Existing independently accepted no-change contract; similar to GP26-06 but not the same prompt/fixture contract.
Existing accepted task/alternative contract; preserve AppKit-specific role/children distinctions and avoid applying UIKit hiding assumptions.
Existing accepted ownership-question contract; completed comparison regression makes conditional advice and AppKit role/children alternatives a priority.
Existing accepted epistemic-control contract; a listed reference is not a retrieval trace.
Existing accepted evidence-boundary contract; target 26, SDK 27 and observed runtime are separate facts, not a feature-introduction inference.
